issues.claim: Все случаи сливаются в один результат, и по отчёту не видно, какие входные данные упали.
issues.problem: If the accumulated message names the inputs and the final check is Assert.Equal("", message), the failure report does show which inputs failed. The claim is overstated. The real flaws are the loop and the manual string building, which are logic that can hide a bug, and the fact that all cases fail as one test. The EN text has the same issue.
issues.suggestedFix: Reword in both locales: "The loop and the manual string concatenation are logic that can have its own bug, such as a skipped case, and every case is reported as one failing test instead of separate results." Keep the Russian equivalent in sync.

issues.claim: The TAP description requires the same: errors other than usage errors are delivered through the returned task. (RU: Описание шаблона TAP требует того же: ошибки, кроме ошибок использования, передаются через возвращаемую задачу.)
issues.problem: The fetched TAP excerpt covers cancellation and progress reporting and is cut off before the Exceptions section. The async-return-types excerpt is truncated right where it starts to discuss exceptions in a returned Task. Neither excerpt shows the specific claim, although it matches known TAP guidance.
issues.suggestedFix: Confirm against the full TAP page (Exceptions section) that usage errors may be thrown synchronously and all other errors are assigned to the returned task. If it cannot be confirmed, soften the sentence to the verified part, for example "an exception thrown inside an async method is stored in the returned task", or cite only the async-return-types section that says so.

issues.claim: The exception is rethrown only when the task is awaited.
issues.problem: The exception is also observed through Task.Wait(), Task.Result and GetAwaiter().GetResult(), so "only when awaited" is slightly imprecise. The RU text has the same wording.
issues.suggestedFix: Write "The exception is rethrown when the task is awaited (or otherwise observed, for example with Wait or Result)", and the equivalent in RU.

issues.problem: The sandbox only ran the fixed source. The buggy snippet's output "FAIL: no exception" and its build (CS1998 and CS4014 warnings) were not checked. My own reading is that it builds and prints FAIL: no exception, with line 8 `action();` as the bug.
